inventory.name: [NopalCyber] DLL Loading by Powershell Empire or Meterpreter

native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] DLL Loading by Powershell Empire or Meterpreter
native_rule.s1ql:
(
  ModulePath EndsWith Anycase 'System.Management.Automation.Dll'
  OR ModulePath EndsWith Anycase 'System.Management.Automation.ni.Dll'
)
AND NOT
(
  src.process.image.path EndsWith Anycase 'installutil.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith Anycase 'Microsoft.EnterpriseManagement.ServiceManager.UI.Console.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith Anycase 'SCCMCliCtrWPF.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase 'Microsoft.EnterpriseManagement.ServiceManager.UI.Console.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase 'SCCMCliCtrWPF.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase 'ScriptEditor.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase 'ScriptRunner.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase '\System32\RemoteFXvGPUDisablement.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase '\System32\sdiagnhost.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase 'azureadconnect.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase 'microsoft.exchange.servicehost.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase 'mmc.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase 'mscorsvw.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase 'powershell.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase 'powershell_ise.exe'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase 'wsmprovhost.exe'
)
AND NOT
(
  src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase 'Microsoft Visual Studio'
  OR src.process.image.path EndsWith AnyCase 'Program Files
  (
    x86
  )
  '
)
